1 HC-KAR (BY SRI. R SHASHIDHARA., ADVOCATE FOR R-1;
 V/O DATED 23.10.2024, SRI.P.B.RAJU., ADV FOR R-2)
 THIS MFA IS FILED U/S 173(1) OF MV ACT AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED06.09.2016 PASSED IN MVC NO.9/2014 ON THE FILE OF THE II ADDITIONAL SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND VI MACT,DAVANAGERE, AWARDING COMPENSATION OF RS.3,88,640/- WITH INTEREST @ 6% P.A.
FROM THE DATE OF PETITION TILL REALIZATION.
THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION

, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM:
MRS . JUSTICE P SREE SUDHA  ORAL JUDGMENT
2. I.A.No.2/2018 is filed by the owner of the vehicle for receiving additional documents but he remained ex-parte before the Tribunal.
Even in the award, it was mentioned that inspite of service of summons to respondent No.1 has not appeared before the Court and he was said to be ex-parte.

3. As such, this Court finds that it is just and reasonable to remand the matter to the Tribunal to give opportunity to respondent No.1 but with a condition that he has to pay interest from the date of setting him NC: 2025:KHC:34972 HC-KAR ex-parte to till today (04.09.2025) on the awarded amount.

4. Tribunal is directed to give reasonable opportunity to both sides for adducing evidence and for advancing arguments and to dispose of the matter afresh, within four months from receipt of the record.
5. The registry is directed to send the record within 10 days.
6. Both the parties are directed to appear before the Tribunal on 26.09.2025 and the amount already deposited is to be sent back to the Tribunal.

Sd/-
